FIELDS.NAME: SecureLock Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
SecureLock Solutions specializes in providing a range of essential locksmith services, including residential and commercial lock installation, repair, and key duplication. Our operations are conducted from a secure, monitored physical location to safeguard our tools and inventory, ensuring minimal risk of theft or vandalism. We pride ourselves on maintaining a clean business record and adhering to all local regulations and licensing requirements. Our team undergoes thorough training in security and safety protocols, enabling us to deliver professional and reliable service to our clients. We do not engage in subcontracting to maintain high quality and accountability over our work, ensuring that all services are performed in-house. With an ongoing commitment to customer satisfaction, we actively manage expectations through a documented customer service policy.

Our locksmith business provides a range of services, including high-security lock installations and safes, and maintains a large inventory of specialized tools and equipment, which collectively exceeds a valuation of $500,000.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses due to equipment damage from a minor water leak on 03/15/2023, resulting in repair costs of $2,500. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe, Grade 1, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrol services contracted for premises protection during non-operational hours.

FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – SecureLock Solutions does not lease employees to or from other employers, as all our staff are directly employed and trained in-house to maintain quality and accountability in our services.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – SecureLock Solutions does not currently carry workers' compensation insurance, which is a statutory requirement for businesses with employees. This policy needs to be in place before we can proceed with coverage.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – SecureLock Solutions does not own or operate any other business, which helps maintain a focused and streamlined operation in locksmith services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – SecureLock Solutions does not have any other insurance policies with this company. The business primarily focuses on locksmith services and does not currently possess additional coverage.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – SecureLock Solutions is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations are solely focused on providing locksmith services, including lock installation, repair, and key duplication.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – SecureLock Solutions does not rent or loan equipment to others, ensuring all services are performed in-house for quality control and accountability. This practice aligns with our operational guidelines and regulatory compliance.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – SecureLock Solutions has maintained a clean financial record with no foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens within the past five years. This demonstrates the company's commitment to fiscal responsibility and stability.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – SecureLock Solutions does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals. The business operations strictly focus on locksmith services, ensuring a safe and compliant environment.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – SecureLock Solutions does not have any catastrophe exposure as their Business Personal Property (BPP) is valued below the specified limit of $500,000, aligning with the program's requirements.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – SecureLock Solutions has no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business has maintained a strong operational record without any such incidents.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – SecureLock Solutions currently has no uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all relevant fire safety regulations.
